headline: Guardant Health, Stock Of The Day, Offers Entry With Earnings Due
summary: Guardant Health is the IBD Stock Of The Day in a thriving market for colon cancer screening tests.  Health and biotech stocks are acting well in the current market.  Several biotech and health names can be found on the IBD 50 list of top growth stocks.

headline: Abbott Laboratories (NYSE:ABT): A Strong Candidate for Quality Investors
summary: Abbott Laboratories (ABT) meets quality investing criteria with strong 8.42% revenue growth, 19.34% ROIC, and near-perfect cash conversion, making it a compelling candidate for long-term investors.
